body.content: Cirrus Semiconductor said its six-inch indium phosphide substrate output doubled in 2026 and that its epitaxial wafer line in Fremont is sold out through 2027.
body.context: Cirrus Semiconductor 8-K, September 2026. The filer is speaking.
